stories.headline: Flood barrier holds through second surge
stories.body: The barrier was raised at first light and stayed up through the second tide.

stories.headline: Harbour gate jammed by hydraulic fault
stories.body: Engineers are working on the seaward ram and expect a fix before the evening tide.

stories.headline: Signal outage halts the coast line
stories.body: Trains are held at both ends of the section while the interlocking is reset.

stories.headline: Survey orders three school roofs closed
stories.body: The survey covered eleven buildings and flagged three for immediate closure.

stories.headline: Power restored to the mill district
stories.body: The last feeder was re-energised shortly after the morning peak.

stories.headline: Ferry service suspended in high wind
stories.body: Crossings are held until the gusts drop below the operating limit.

stories.headline: Boil-water notice lifted for two wards
stories.body: Sampling came back clear on three consecutive rounds before the notice was lifted.

stories.headline: Weight limit imposed on the old bridge
stories.body: Heavy goods traffic is diverted through the valley road until the deck is assessed.

stories.headline: Storm shelter opens at the leisure centre
stories.body: Camp beds and hot food are in place for anyone moved off the low ground.

stories.headline: Tunnel reopens ahead of schedule
stories.body: Resurfacing finished a full shift early and both bores are back in use.

stories.headline: Market hall evacuated after gas alert
stories.body: Traders were moved to the square while the main is isolated and vented.

stories.headline: Clinic hours extended through the weekend
stories.body: Extra sessions were added after the backlog from the closure week.

stories.headline: Quarry road washed out below the ridge
stories.body: A culvert gave way overnight and took most of the eastbound lane with it.

stories.headline: Broadband restored after cable strike
stories.body: A splice team worked through the night on the cut beside the depot access.
